spark.scene: True-color view of the main Hawaiian Islands chain from northwest to southeast over dark ocean with scattered white cumulus and cirrus, heaviest over windward slopes and to the southwest, eastern side of the southeasternmost large island cloud-covered.

track.note: Centroid drift of a plume still attached to its source is slower than the air; direction is the main signal, speed is approximate.

evidence: USGS HVO at image time: Kilauea WATCH/ORANGE in episodic_pause with paused Halemaumau eruption, Mauna Loa NORMAL/GREEN not erupting; if volcanic, Kilauea is the favored vent. [E1]

FIRMS on 2026-09-21 in plume box shows zero fire clusters but 161 Kilauea-summit volcanic-thermal pixels, arguing against wildfire_smoke and supporting ongoing volcanic heat/degassing during pause. [E3]

Geometry trails from Kilauea area: upwind end 26.5 km from Kilauea vs 61.4 km from Mauna Loa, and tracked inferred source end 29.7 km from Kilauea vs 64.6 km from Mauna Loa southwest of the island. [E7, E5]

Motion supports westward transport: measured drift toward 268 deg at ~5.6 km/h vs centroid wind from 107 deg (blows toward ~287 deg), agreement within ~19 deg, but fit quality is weak (R2 0.35). [E5, E2]

Disagreement lowers confidence: wind at inferred source end from 24 deg (blows toward ~204 deg) differs ~64 deg from measured drift toward 268 deg, indicating local terrain-driven wind variability. [E5, E8]

Visual thin diffuse gray translucent veil southwest over ocean grayer/fainter than surrounding bright white cumulus/cirrus, distinct from cloud; detection is very faint with high land fraction 0.875 over Hawaii indicating mask overlap/contamination. [E6, E5]

evidence_cited.text: USGS HVO at image time: Kilauea WATCH/ORANGE in episodic_pause with paused Halemaumau eruption, Mauna Loa NORMAL/GREEN not erupting; if volcanic, Kilauea is the favored vent.
FIRMS on 2026-09-21 in plume box shows zero fire clusters but 161 Kilauea-summit volcanic-thermal pixels, arguing against wildfire_smoke and supporting ongoing volcanic heat/degassing during pause.
Geometry trails from Kilauea area: upwind end 26.5 km from Kilauea vs 61.4 km from Mauna Loa, and tracked inferred source end 29.7 km from Kilauea vs 64.6 km from Mauna Loa southwest of the island.
Motion supports westward transport: measured drift toward 268 deg at ~5.6 km/h vs centroid wind from 107 deg (blows toward ~287 deg), agreement within ~19 deg, but fit quality is weak (R2 0.35).
Disagreement lowers confidence: wind at inferred source end from 24 deg (blows toward ~204 deg) differs ~64 deg from measured drift toward 268 deg, indicating local terrain-driven wind variability.

Visual thin diffuse gray translucent veil southwest over ocean grayer/fainter than surrounding bright white cumulus/cirrus, distinct from cloud; detection is very faint with high land fraction 0.875 over Hawaii indicating mask overlap/contamination.

classify.caveats: Single very-faint streak in partly cloudy scene with low SAM confidence and weak motion fit (R2 0.35); Kilauea officially in episodic pause, not actively fountaining; mask has high land overlap (0.875); winds vary spatially with source-end wind disagreeing with drift, so volcanic attribution is plausible but not certain.
